tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad dang / gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen rtse'i spyi gzugs mchog /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /khyad par bsil ldan ljongs kyi yab gcig nyid/ /dpag med 'phrin las mnga' ba khyod la 'dud/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pas mchod/ /bcas rang nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /khyad par tshe 'di'i drin can pha ma la/ /brnyas thabs tshig ngan gang shor mthol lo bshags/ /'khor 'das dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang / /rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /phyi ma bde can gru 'dzin la sogs su/ /skyes nas theg chen sa lam mthar phyin te/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /bdag sogs mar gyur mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /ji ltar smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ bya bral ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o/ /maṅga lam// ༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs la gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs bzhugs so// mgon med mgon gyur mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /nyam thag nga ro 'bod 'di brtse bas dgongs/ /bdag rang bag spro'i gdeng dang mi ldan zhing / /bzang brdzu g.yo can ri dwags rngon 'dra ba'i/ /khrel 'das sdig ldan bdag gi mgon mdzod gcig /bdag gi gnas tshul ma 'dres gsal le ni/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs kyis dgongs par zad/ /lus 'tsho la dor 'khos kyis rang gzhan la/ /phan na chos mthun bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /'bad mi dgos par lhun grub mgon pos mdzod/

/de ltar min na sdig rten rnam smin lus/ /myur khrol gru 'dzin gnas su 'dren par mdzod/ /khyod zhal mngon sum mthong ba'i skal med na'ang / /rmi lam tsam du'ang lung tsam mi ston na/ /bdag cag lnga dbang 'gyur 'di tha tshig lags/ /tshul 'di dgongs shig tshad med thugs rje can/ /'di'ang sangs rgyas phun tshogs gyis gsol ba'o/ /maṅga lam// // ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gdung shugs kyis gsol ba'i tshigs bcad// oṃ swa sti/ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /khyad par gru 'dzin mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /sgrib med ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan rnams/ /thugs bskyed smon lam dbang gis dgongs su gsol/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa chen po'i dge mtshan gyis/ /yid la bcags pa'i don 'di da lta sgrubs/ /mi bzad las kyis mnar ba bdag cag ni/ /mthun 'jug 'jig rten bya bas sdug bsngal nas/ /lus rten 'dir dor gru 'dzin gnas su skyes/ /snying stobs che dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /thob nas rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho yis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag dam par shog /khyad par ltos bcas gyi nar 'khyams pa rnams/ /myur du mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /dpal la spyad nas byang chub mchog thob par/ /smon pa'i gnas 'di gegs med 'grub gyur cig /'brug lo sa ga zla ba'i rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dus chen gyi tshe/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis/ yi dam du byas pa'i tha tshig dge /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
